sentences: My skin felt too dry.
Mum sent me to the shop.
We wait at the bus stop.
Papa told me of a brave chief. The chief kept his men safe and they were all glad. I wish to be brave too.
Snow falls all week. I want to play, so I put on my warm coat. We make a big snowman out back. My toes are cold but I am glad to have fun!
My dog has soft brown ears.
The tall boy can help me.
The cold snow fell all day.
The wind woke me up. I began to hear it just above my room. I went to check the time. It was six. Time moved slowly. I took each step with care and went back to bed. Soon I saw the sun again.
I won an award this year! Mum and dad agreed I did my best, and they allowed me to buy a gift that I want. Yeah! What can a child ask for? Toys, yes, toys!
My cat has a long tail.
I wish for a new toy.
I want more cake and milk.

I wake up and wash my face. I brush my hair and put on my black shoes. I wear them on most days. Then I take my bag, and mum and I walk to the bus stop. We wait and talk. When the bus comes, I get on and find a seat.
We play chase in the yard. My dog runs after me, and I turn and chase him! He is so glad, and he runs after his tail when we stop! We slip on the wet path. We have so much fun!
My coat keeps me so warm.
I wash my face and hands.
Yeah, we won the big game!
I carry my blocks into the room. I build a fine ship with them! It is true art, mum says! I once took an hour to build such a ship, but now I am fast. I tell mum to come and see.
Our class had a test on new words, and we all did well. So we put on a word show for our mums and dads! I read my best words out loud, like a real star. They cheered and cheered!
My mum makes the best cake.
We rest and eat at break time.
The soil is good for the rose.
Mum and I walk along the path. I am not alone. I spot a fat cat below the big red sign. The cat sits ahead of us, glad in the sun. I like being out with mum.
Each April, we go to a farm. I pick red apples for mum. We sort the apples by size, and the farm sells some at its shop. Mum makes a pie at home.
I build a home with each block.
We went to the sea last year.
I sit on the old chair made of wood.
My pet bunny is soft and brown. It hops onto my seat and sits by me. I make it my job to feed it good food each day. Candy is for me, not for pets! I am sure it is glad.
A tiny chick lives in the nest. One day it will fly away into the wild. I sing a song and it seems to like it.
The road home is very wide.
The bird flew high above me.
We play again in the park.

I bring the bowl and the tools for mum. We begin to make the bread. An egg rolls off the top, but I catch it just in time! The bread comes out thin on one side, but it is still so good. We send some to the man next door.
As it is about to rain, our team takes a vote. We all vote to stop the game as it is not safe to play on.
The bus is just up ahead.
We go along the long road.
I agree that dogs are the best.
We went on a trip to a town in the west. Dad and I swam in a wide lake. Then we sat by a very tall tree that grew over the old town wall, and we took in the view. We stayed till the sun set.
I had a big board made of wood. I made it red all over with a brush, built the sides and put a chart on it. The rest of the class asked me to show them the work that I had done thus far.
